charging_plan.objective: least total trip time: driving + charging + a fixed overhead per stop
charging_plan.algorithm: Label-setting shortest path over (place, battery level) states. Places are the origin, every candidate station and the destination; every pair is joined by its road leg. At each stop the planner either charges just enough for the next leg or charges to the cap. For charging time that is linear in energy this 'fill or just enough' choice contains an optimal plan (Khuller, Malekian and Mestre, 'To fill or not to fill: the gas station problem', 2011). A label is dropped when another label at the same place is no slower, has at least as much battery and no more stops. The first label to reach the destination has the least total time.
